這些是 2025 到 2026 年，大家在報名表和測驗回饋裡寫下的話。我們沒有改: These are words people wrote in our sign-up forms and test feedback in 2025 and 2026. We removed names and anything that could identify someone and tidied the punctuation, without changing the meaning. They were originally written in Chinese; this page shows English translations.
「我很喜歡 Molly 在介紹 12 語根時說的話：12 語根是我們都擁有的，只: "I love what Molly said when she introduced the 12 Root Codes: we all have all twelve; we just use them in different proportions. Each story and song helped me understand how that Root Code works… In most of the stories, I really did see traces of how I've lived!"
「很動人共鳴；終於有人聽懂我的心聲。」: "So moving, so resonant. Someone finally understands what's in my heart."
「語根歌曲超好聽的，讓人流淚。被理解的感覺真好，謝謝。」: "The Root Code songs are so beautiful they made me cry. It feels so good to be understood. Thank you."
「我覺得總體設計得蠻好的。感謝你們創造這個系統，讓更多迷茫的人來認識自己。」: "I think the overall design is really good. Thank you for creating this system so more people who feel lost can get to know themselves."
「謝謝頻率文明，讓人們有機會可以面對並成為真實的自己。」: "Thank you, Frequency Civilization, for giving people the chance to face themselves and become who they really are."
「一直以來，我都是以邏輯理性自居……現在我好像找到了一個出路。」: "I've always seen myself as logical and rational… Now I feel I may have found a way forward."
「我感覺自己真的有這些面向在展現，而且我似乎更知道了，我有時在運用哪些特性。好有: "I really do feel these sides of me showing up, and I seem to know better now which traits I'm using at different times. So interesting."
「謝謝遇見 12 語根，讓我看見自己沒有被發現的特質。」: "I'm grateful I found the 12 Root Codes. They showed me traits in myself I'd never noticed."
「聽了頻率文明的音樂很有感覺。我不知道為何，但我的心產生了共振，我想一定有什麼觸: "Frequency Civilization's music really moved me. I don't know why, but my heart resonated. Something must have touched me."
「覺得 Molly 很厲害，希望能夠幫上妳，也要照顧自己身體喔！」: "Molly, you're amazing. I hope I can help you. And please take care of yourself!"
「等待開場的音樂時，不知怎的眼淚就流下來了，整個下午嘴角幾乎自然維持上揚。感恩大: "While I waited for the music to start, tears just came, I don't know why. I was smiling almost the whole afternoon. Thank you all for a wonderful afternoon."
「我也在學習成為自己，感謝妳的出現……有共鳴的是妳為他人服務的心。妳很有力量，像: "I'm also learning to become myself. Thank you for being here… What resonated was your heart for serving others. You are powerful, like golden light."
「謝謝你在我最低迷的時候，依然保持那份純淨與清明，讓我重新找回內在的平衡。」: "Thank you for staying clear and pure when I was at my lowest. It helped me find my inner balance again."
「謝謝妳帶給這世界美好，想給妳一個大擁抱！」: "Thank you for bringing something beautiful into the world. I want to give you a big hug!"
「有人的解說，有文字和音樂的搭配，感覺更完整了，讓我更懂這些語根的意涵。」: "With someone explaining, and words and music together, it felt more complete, and I understood the Root Codes better."
「謝謝這個場域。雖然還沒能想像之後實際發展的樣子，但相信能讓所有接觸的人，更接近: "Thank you for this space. I can't yet picture how it will grow, but I believe it can bring everyone it touches closer to the world they hope for."
「謝謝你讓我想像中的世界落地存在。」: "Thank you for making the world I imagined real."
「不管你在哪裡，你的存在本身就已經很有力量了。」: "Wherever you are, your presence alone is already powerful."
「我也看到自己的確有某些面向，很符合某些語根的精神。音樂會的最後，感覺大家都坐著: "I also saw that some sides of me really match the spirit of certain Root Codes. At the end of the concert, it felt like everyone just stayed seated. No one wanted to leave."
「感謝此問卷，讓我更認識自己與定位自己的位置！」: "Thank you for this questionnaire. It helped me know myself better and find my place!"
「感覺創造出一個有趣的測驗，再去從不同的面向看見自己。」: "It feels like you've made a fun test that lets me see myself from different angles."
「這個系統對於尚未清楚了解自己的人，會有幫助釐清的效果。」: "For people who don't yet understand themselves clearly, this system can help bring clarity."
「這次搭配 Molly 的介紹解說，讓頻率文明的概念可以更清楚完整……這次梳理一: "With Molly's introduction this time, the idea of Frequency Civilization became clearer and more complete… Having it laid out like this, I resonate with the whole vision even more."
「謝謝你用心規劃，讓我更認識自己。」: "Thank you for planning this so carefully. It helped me know myself better."
「……整體的測驗下來覺得很有趣，謝謝這麼用心的設計。」: "…Taking the whole test was really fun. Thank you for such a thoughtful design."
「目前是學生，偶然看到語根導入影片，頗為共鳴……在此致上感謝，以及祝福。」: "I'm a student, and I happened to see the Root Code introduction video. It really resonated… My thanks, and my best wishes."
「我就是被頻道裡播放的那首歌感動到，就循著進到這裡了！……希望在這裡學習，讓自己: "I was moved by a song on the channel and followed it here!… I hope to learn here, so I can truly become a light for others and bring warmth to the people around me."

「12 語根歌曲有著不同的旋律、曲風，使我有不同的感受和畫面，加上 Molly: "Each of the 12 Root Code songs has its own melody and style, and each gave me different feelings and images. Together with Molly's lyrics and stories, it was truly beautiful and stayed with me."
